items.title: Obtain and renew a City of Henderson business license
items.description: Any business activity in the city needs a city business license, even if the business is located outside the city limits or holds a license from another city, in addition to the Nevada state business license. The fee depends on the classification, of which there are nearly 100. Food businesses also need a Southern Nevada Health District permit before they start, and privileged licenses need City Council approval before issue. A renewal received after its due date carries a 10% penalty, whether or not the reminder arrived.
items.deadline: Before operating; renew on or before the due date

feeDetail.note: The city sets the fee by business classification; it advises confirming the amount for a specific classification.

items.title: Obtain City of Las Vegas business license
items.authority: City of Las Vegas Business Licensing (with Clark County for unincorporated areas)
items.description: A business with its address inside the City of Las Vegas needs a city business license, after the state business license and zoning and certificate-of-occupancy checks. General licenses are applied for online; privilege licenses need an appointment. A business outside city limits is licensed by Clark County, North Las Vegas or Henderson.

penalty.note: The city's published pages for this item give no late-penalty amount.

items.title: File fictitious firm name with the Clark County Clerk
items.description: A business that operates under a name that does not show the real name of each owner files a fictitious firm name certificate with the County Clerk of each county where it operates. The $25 filing fee includes one copy, the form needs no notary, and the name is renewed every five years.

items.title: Obtain and renew a North Las Vegas business license
items.authority: City of North Las Vegas Business License Division
items.description: Anyone who conducts business in the city, or runs a business based in the city, needs a city business license before operations begin, with a separate license for each branch, establishment or location. Renewal opens 30 days before the license expires and fees must be paid before the expiration date to avoid a penalty, whether or not a notice arrived. A license that stays unpaid for 60 days after it expires is revoked.
items.deadline: Before operating; renew before the license expires (renewal opens 30 days before)

penalty.note: The city's published pages for this item give no late-penalty amount.

items.title: Obtain and renew a City of Reno business license
items.description: Businesses in the city need a city business license in addition to the Nevada state business license. A general license runs 12 months from the first day of the month the business starts and is renewed each year online through the regional onenv.us portal. A late renewal carries a 50% penalty, and so does starting before the license is issued. Liquor and gaming licenses follow a quarterly cycle.
items.deadline: Renew each year, by the end of the 12-month license term

feeDetail.note: The city says the fee is based on the license classification, of which there are over 100.

penalty.note: 50% for a late renewal or for starting before the license is issued.
